sloka: श्रूयताम् राम वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वार्थम् वचनम् मम ।अहम् शूर्पणखा नाम राक्षसी कामरूपिणी ॥३-१७-२०॥
transliteration: śrūyatām rāma vakṣyāmi tattvārtham vacanam mama ।aham śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī ॥3-17-20॥

translations.english: Tell me truly what you have come here for. Having heard the words of Rama and overtaken by passion, the demoness said:
